query:
UPDATE draft
                   SET value = to_json(
                       CASE WHEN to_jsonb(value) -> $4::text = to_jsonb($2::text)
                            THEN jsonb_set(to_jsonb(value), ARRAY[$4::text], to_jsonb($1::text), false)
                            ELSE to_jsonb(value)
                       END
                   )
                   WHERE id = ANY($3)
